description.narrative:
The second Africa Climate Summit (ACS2) seeks to convene African leaders, investors, and global stakeholders to strengthen African unity and climate leadership, particularly in preparation for COP30. The summit will be held in Addis Ababa at the Addis International Convention Center (AICC) on September 8th to 10th 2025. A central objective is to reframe Africa’s global role - from being perceived primarily as a victim of climate change to becoming an active leader and part of the solution. The summit will further promote nature-based and endogenous solutions, mobilize climate finance and green investments, accelerate energy access, and foster global partnerships and structural reforms.
Ethiopia will host the summit together with the African Union (AU). Ethiopia is strongly committed to the green transition and actively seeks to position itself on the international stage. In recent years, the AU has taken significant steps onto the international climate stage, demonstrating high amitions and increasing engagement. The African Climate Summit is a result of this. ASC2 provides a crucial platform for political leaders and other stakeholders of Africa to discuss the green transition and shape a common African climate position ahead of COP30.
Norwegian support can help ensure a successful summit while also strengthening its partnership with the Government of Ethiopia and the AU, with whom we share many mutual interests regarding the green transition.
